summary: The commit (ce3df3f) appends exactly the 4 new X post analysis rows described in the task title to ai-os/X_POST_AI_ANALYSIS_2026-07-23.md, a single additive change to a documentation/data-tracking markdown file with no code, config, schema, auth, or workflow-file involvement.
